_comment: Measured numbers that tools/gate_slots.py turns into the slot count and the jobs per slot (docs/validation.md, Gate slots). Measured 2026-11-13 on the 24-core, 122 GB host: a sampler read the whole process tree of a keep-going gate every 5 s (gate-slots-sample: --affected bringup~30..HEAD, 339 steps, 839 s, mean 5.3 busy cores on the host with p95 10.7 and a 23.9 build peak, peak resident set 10.9 GB, MemAvailable never under 110 GB) and the idle host (1.1 busy cores, about 3 with the board runner and builds outside the gate).

image_builds._comment: How many images a gate builds at once (tools/gate_slots.py image_builds); each gets the slot's build cores divided by this count, rounded up. Measured 2026-11-13: the 21 image builds of an affected gate (the project recipes left out), configured and built from empty directories, then rebuilt after touching kernel/scheduler/freertos.c, with a sampler on the whole process tree every 0.1 s. One at a time with -j 7: 168 s and 135 s, peak 0.75 GB (0.8 GB in a first pass under a load of 60). Three at a time with -j 3: 72 s and 48 s, peak 1.0 GB in all. Three with -j 7 gave 51 s and 36 s but 21 compile jobs per slot; four with -j 2 gave 69 s and 58 s under a load of 60. peak_rss_gb is one build at -j 7, which bounds one at a lower -j.

perturb._comment: checks/scheduler-control-linked.py: QEMU runs on the instruction counter, so a run's host time is its instruction work, not the host load (serial and eight at once measured 85.1 s and 85.7 s for the slowest point, perturb-scheduler-partitioned-qemu-control-open-3000, 30 runs, 427 s in all). The kill limit is a hang backstop: kill_multiplier times the slowest measured point.

latency_control._comment: checks/latency-control-integration.py runs the control models on one TCG thread with a fixed icount (24 concurrent runs under 24 busy processes and 10 alone gave one identical log); the busy model with --allow-runtime-error takes 33.0 s, with --negative-wrapper-order 33.5 s, the idle model 15.6 s. The kill limit is a hang backstop: kill_multiplier times the slowest.
